## Use When

Use when arranging headers, banners, forms, and metrics in v2 consumers.

## Do

- Use Stack for consistent vertical rhythm.
- Keep admin flows compact.
- Use larger gaps only between major page sections.

## Do Not

- Replace Stack with arbitrary margins everywhere.
- Apply storefront-style airy spacing to admin by default.

## Example

Use one Stack to order header, feedback, and content on an admin page.
